title: Password reset
brief:
A password reset email for Orbit.

- Preview text: "Your reset link expires in 30 minutes."
- Orbit logo at the top: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-logo.png (252×128 file, show it 126px wide).
- Heading: "Reset your password"
- Paragraph: "We received a request to reset the password for your Orbit account."
- Button "Reset password" linking to https://orbit.dev/reset?token=abc123, background #6d5efc, white text, rounded corners.
- Small text: "This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email."
- Footer: "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco"
- Light grey page background (#f1f2f6), white 600px content card.
